evals.prompt: Please review the pull request for my current branch. Keep it read-only and tell me whether it is safe to merge. Focus on actual bugs, not style.
evals.expected_output: Pins the live PR state, examines the full diff and related context, reads CI results instead of running builds, typechecks, or tests, and returns a concise evidence-based verdict without posting to GitHub.

evals.prompt: Re-review PR #482 after the author pushed a fix for the duplicate webhook delivery issue. Tell me whether the old finding is fixed, and post an inline blocking comment only if it is still broken.
evals.expected_output: Refreshes the PR state before reviewing, explicitly resolves the prior finding, checks adjacent retry and failure paths, and avoids duplicate threads. If the finding remains, shows the exact inline comment and target line, waits for the user's approval, then refreshes the head again before posting.

evals.prompt: Review this PR and leave inline comments for any real issue. Use Conventional Comments. Ignore formatting and naming issues.
evals.expected_output: Finds only well-supported issues, labels each with a Conventional Comments label and decoration, and omits excluded style categories. Shows the exact comments and target lines, waits for the user's approval, stages them as a pending review, and submits only when the user says to submit.
